proposed_widenings.name: block_hp_recovery
proposed_widenings.justification: The 'unable to regain Hit Points' effect is not a named SRD condition and has no existing EffectAtom. It is mechanically distinct from block_max_hp_reduction (which only prevents max HP from going down) — this atom prevents current HP from being restored by any means (healing spells, potions, regeneration, etc.) for a timed duration.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain Hit Points for 1 hour

proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRiderResult widening
proposed_widenings.justification: SaveGateRiderResult currently only supports { kind: 'apply_condition' } or { kind: 'none' }. The Sword of Wounding's save failure result is 'block_hp_recovery', which is not a Condition. SaveGateRiderResult needs to admit a broader EffectAtom (or at least the new block_hp_recovery atom) so magic-item save riders can express non-condition failure effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain Hit Points for 1 hour

proposed_widenings.name: MasteryEffect composite / damage support
proposed_widenings.justification: MasteryEffect is a union of ModifyRollAdvantageRider | SaveGateRider | GrantWeaponAttackRider. Sword of Wounding needs both a raw damage instance (2d6 Necrotic) AND a save_gate on the same hit. There is no composite variant and no EffectAtom.damage variant in MasteryEffect. Either MasteryEffect needs to admit a composite form, or OnHitTriggerMechanics needs to carry a ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<MasteryEffect>.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw

proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRider repeatSave field
proposed_widenings.justification: SaveGateRider has no repeatSave field. The Sword of Wounding's save-to-end pattern (repeat at end of each turn, ends on success) is identical in structure to the spell-level RepeatSaveSpec already on ActivationPhase.save_gate. SaveGateRider needs an analogous optional repeatSave field to express this cadence on mastery/item on-hit riders.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

notes: The on_hit_trigger family exists in MagicItemComponentMechanics and is the correct family for this unit. All four widenings are surface/atom gaps that prevent honest encoding; none require a new top-level family. The primary blocker (atom_widening) is block_hp_recovery — a timed prevention of all HP regain. The three surface_widening gaps (SaveGateRiderResult, MasteryEffect composites, SaveGateRider.repeatSave) are co-required: fixing only the atom without widening the rider types still cannot express the unit.
